name: stack-guide
description: The reader's way in: one skill that answers a question about this marketplace from what is on disk — what devbook, the delivery engine, the bridges, the surfaces, and the fan-out lane are and how they fit, which version of each plugin is installed against the newest published, which are enabled, and how a repository has wired its roles, extension points, gates, and policy — backed by a read-only report that names the file behind every fact. Plus stack-init and stack-update, which own the engine keys of .github/ai-agent-stack.json and hand every component's materialization to that component's own sync skill. Declares no dependency: a plugin it names but cannot find is reported as not installed.
